hero_intro.name: hero_intro
hero_intro.default: 'FARE Farms is an Afro-Indigenous-centred land and food initiative advancing agricultural knowledge, food sovereignty, cultural preservation, and community stewardship. Through community gardens, education, cultural exchange, and land-based learning, we create opportunities to reconnect with food, land, and ancestral knowledge.'

roots_body.name: roots_body
roots_body.default: 'Food is more than nourishment. It carries memory, identity, resilience, and knowledge passed between generations. FARE Farms creates space to explore, preserve, and share agricultural traditions while learning from the responsibilities of stewardship on Indigenous lands.'

pillars_intro.name: pillars_intro
pillars_intro.default: 'Discover agricultural heritage, learn culturally meaningful growing practices, care for the land, and build community.'

seed_to_story_intro.name: seed_to_story_intro
seed_to_story_intro.default: 'Every crop has a story. Explore the histories, growing practices, cultural significance, and food traditions connected to plants that nourish our communities.'

gardens_intro.name: gardens_intro
gardens_intro.default: 'Our growing spaces support hands-on education, intergenerational learning, ecological care, and cultural connection.'

land_acknowledgment.name: land_acknowledgment
land_acknowledgment.default: 'We acknowledge that we grow on the unceded traditional territories of the xʷməθkʷəy̓əm (Musqueam), Sḵwx̱wú7mesh (Squamish), and səlilwətaɬ (Tsleil-Waututh) Nations.'

intro.name: intro
intro.default: 'We envision a community-rooted marketplace celebrating culturally meaningful foods, seeds, growing supplies, educational resources, and products created by local growers and makers.'
